name: restful-booker-api-automation
description: End-to-end automated REST API test suite built with Postman, Newman, Ajv JSON Schema validation, and GitHub Actions CI.

scripts.test: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker-qa.postman_environment.json --env-var "password=password123" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful Booker API Test Report" --reporter-htmlextra-darkTheme
